audit: 2026-09-08 scheduled remote agent p2: 50 Qs in one batch across all four topics (Psychiatry 14, Paediatrics 13, Obstetrics and Gynaecology 12, Medicine 11), published as ten 5-question files to stay inside the tool payload limit. Per-question deficit selection was run on the active L3-L5 tier because the closed legacy L1-L2 inventory of about 28 to 31 per cent per topic makes the whole-topic denominator unreachable. Every topic entered the run at 49.2 to 49.3 per cent L3, 44.2 per cent L4 and 6.5 per cent L5, so L5 sat above its 5 per cent target in all four topics and none was generated; the running deficit alternated between L3 and L4 within each topic, giving 26 L3 and 24 L4 and zero L1 or L2. Correct-letter distribution A10 B10 C10 D10 E10; worst option length parity 1.23 across all 50 with the correct option the longest in 12; zero non-ASCII characters, zero em-dashes and zero banned tokens; every rationale carries an inline source and every source_ref matches a label in that question sources array; no stem or id duplicates against the existing bank; every stem positions the candidate as the treating doctor; no lead-in guideline leaks, no pertinent-negative parentheticals in any correct option and no follow local guidelines non-options.
